title: BdoExport
description: The website's data export, schema 0.5.7. Three documents per game build: one ClassExport per class (and spec), the Manifest, and the Golden vectors. docs/export-format.md is the prose companion (ids, grades, changelog).

PublicGrade.description: How a value is known, in public words. game data: read from the shipped files (or a census over them). measured: observed in game. inferred: a rule consistent with the data, not read directly. needs value: not known; an editor fills it.

SpecList.description: How a spec lists a skill: pressable (in the skill list), reached_through (not pressable in this spec, reached from another skill), or null (not in the spec).

Key.description: A game input: Mouse0 (LMB), Mouse1 (RMB), W A S D, Shift, Space, Q E F C Z X, Tab.

Condition.description: One non-input test of a relationship (a learned skill, a runtime state, an action variable, the class resource, the weapon stance, another test). `named` grades the NAME of the test, not whether it holds.

skill.description: learned / not_learned: the game skill id

Assumed.description: A resource / gear / class test the best-case profile assumed met (full resources, gear worn, content on).

start_f.description: the clip frame the action starts at

end_f.description: the frame it ends at when nothing cancels it (its cut, else the clip length); null when no length is known

frames.description: the clip's length in frames (30 per second of animation)

Clock.description: THE PER-ACTION CLOCK. ms for a clip span [lo, hi) at speeds S: effective frames = the span at `rate`, with each speed event replacing the rate from its frame (for remain*speed*30 frames when remain > 0, else to the end; the last event still covering a frame wins); ms = frames / 30 / (S[pool]/100) * 1000 (pool 'none': 100) plus the slow-motion excess, rounded to 0.1. Golden vectors pin it.

items.description: [frame, speed, remain seconds (0 or absent = until the end)]

Tick.description: One damage hit of an action. Its % per line is damage_lines[line].pct (null = not known).

id.description: <action>@<frame>#<n>: n counts the action's damage ticks at the same frame

skill.description: the game skill id the hit names

if.description: the hit fires when ANY of these holds

Flight.description: A projectile's flight (game data), except range (inferred). Its impact area is not in the game data.

Area.description: A melee hit area (game data). Attacker at the origin facing forward; world units (100 per metre, inferred). plus_body: the game adds the attacker's scale and body radius to `radius`.

Row.description: One selection row of an action, in engine order: the edges it offers from `from_f` (own walk rows: from the start). Within a row the FIRST passing edge is taken.

via.description: 'own' (the action's own walk) or the shared group's name

list.description: key into `edge_lists`: the row's edge ids in engine order

Edge.description: A RELATIONSHIP: from the action whose row lists it, to an action (and the skill it enters). continuation: the skill's own next action; exit: into another skill (or a skill press); repeat: back into the same action.

to_skill.description: graph skill key, null for a continuation inside the same skill

window.description: [first, last] clip frame of the FROM action, inclusive

end.description: fires when the from action ends

plays.description: for an edge into a skill PRESS (`to` = SKILL_<n>): the action that press plays

sets.description: key into `set_lists`: the action variable writes its frame events make

on_cooldown.description: pressed on cooldown, the game plays `action` instead
{entry action: the action played instead on cooldown}

DamageLine.description: What one damage line of a skill deals. pct is present only for lines the line rule settles (rule single or agree); otherwise null with a reason, for an editor. Never 0.

script_hits.description: the effect script's x N for each term carrying this % (shipped data; empty when hidden)

script_max.description: the effect script's max repeats for each term carrying this % (null = none)

grade.description: the line's value as a whole: never stronger than its line mapping

line.description: damage line id (its % is damage_lines[line].pct); null when the hit names no line (`line_reason`)

line_reason.description: why `line` is null: the hit event names no damage line

Followup.description: A skill the cast can go into at or after the preset's final hit (ADR 0004 item 5): the time from entering the preset's first action to entering `to`.

group.description: plain label: the card(s) it enters, the skill, or "any skill on the hotbar"

at.description: the action the follow-up leaves from

f.description: the frame of `at` it opens at

plays.description: for a follow-up into a skill PRESS (`to` = SKILL_<n>): the action that press plays

cards.description: the card(s) the follow-up enters: the first damage of the action it enters, read by the card rule; several when its branches deal several (a `cards` id each)

no_card.description: why `cards` is empty ('no damage card: ...'), else null

opens_f.description: the clip frame of `at` the exit itself opens at (before clamping to the final hit)

true_cancel.description: the exit opens before the final hit (the page’s "true cancel" tag)

hotbar.description: any skill on the hotbar (a quickslot / console-slot press): one per preset or timeline, the earliest; no card

opens.description: where in its action the hotbar row opens

raw_row.description: the engine row (group) the exit is on — not for display

ultimate.description: entered through a route-only Ultimate (its command opens this route into the base card) 0.5.7: set only for a real Ultimate (route kind `ultimate`); see `route`.

Preset.description: One cast of one skill reaching a set of damage groups by the path that lands the final hit earliest (ADR 0004 items 2-5). Its time at any speeds = the action clock summed over `segments`.

key.description: <skill>(:<entry action>|@<loop root action>)[~cooldown]|<group>+<group>...; one preset per skill, ENTRY action and group set (the main cast keys its first action, a loop variant its root); a group is <action>[i-j], the 1-based ordinals of its ticks in the action

hold.description: the entry keys that must stay down after the entry (press vs hold)

alternatives.description: 0.5.7: other key sets that enter the first action the same way (same sources, same conditions but the keys): the how says 'K or K2' (Imminent Doom: LMB or RMB)

after.description: 0.5.7: a route fold entered from the card's OWN cast: that cast's press keys, said first ('Press Shift + E, then press LMB'); else null

on_cooldown.description: pressed on cooldown, or plays an on-cooldown action (the best-case profile is off cooldown)

speed_flip.description: another path is faster at 150% of one speed (flagged, not re-picked)

card.description: the skill the preset's damage hits name (a `cards` id)

card_rule.description: how the card was read from the hits: single skill, or the family-majority rule (docs/presets.md, Cards)

card_key.description: <card>(:<entry action>|@<loop root action>)[~cooldown]|<group>+...; unique in a spec file

on_cooldown_via.description: 'entry' (pressed on cooldown) or 'plays <action>' (plays an on-cooldown action, however reached); null off cooldown

specs.description: per spec: the card id the preset is shown under (e.g. Succession: Beak Kick for Absolute: Beak Kick's hits), or null when the spec does not show it

reached_through.description: per spec: the edges of another kept skill that reach this preset's first action, when its card is shown only because it is reached that way (a superseded Absolute / lower rank, ADR 0004 item 7); else null

how.description: the whole preset in a player’s words, one frame-free sentence (docs/presets.md "How it’s played"); null when the player does nothing of their own

access.description: key into `access_lists`: every way into the preset (item 10)

no_entry.description: why the access list is empty, else null

entry_action.description: the cast’s first action: the preset is the fastest path for its group set FROM this action

ultimate.description: entered through a route-only Ultimate (its command opens this route into the base card) 0.5.7: set only for a real Ultimate (route kind `ultimate`); see `route`.

requirements.description: buff (ids only; buff.dbss not parsed) and class-resource requirements of the entry (shared by every entering condset) and of each choice

distinguishing.description: what separates this entry from the other presets of its card with the same visible entry keys (empty when none share them)

via_hotbar.description: reached only by a hotbar press of the skill: the keyboard rows take an earlier class-resource branch first

how_fallback.description: why the sentence leaves a timing out (empty: every step said)

timed.description: a timed PLAYER action: any choice that is not automatic (a press, release, hold-through, charge, hotbar or skill-command step)

weapon_switch.description: entered through the class's Awakening weapon switch: its command only switches the weapon and hands off into this card (precedence 2, folded; the input stays on the entry)

Dropped.description: {reason: {count, names: {name: n}}} — what the exporter left out, by reason and by name.

files.description: shipped file -> what is read from it

edge_lists.description: list id -> edge ids, shared by every row that offers the same edges

set_lists.description: list id -> variable writes, shared by every action that makes the same ones

segment_lists.description: list id -> segments, shared by follow-ups

damage_source.description: where the damage lines and hit areas were read

presets_family_roots.description: whether the presets had the skill families (skilltype.dbss) their cast-end rule needs: 'ok', 'unavailable: <reason>', or 'not generated'. export_check fails unless 'ok'.

cards.description: card id (a game skill id: the skill the presets' damage hits name, ADR 0004 item 7) -> the card

presets_family_roots.description: whether the presets had the skill families (skilltype.dbss) their cast-end rule needs: 'ok', 'unavailable: <reason>', or 'not generated'. export_check fails unless 'ok'.

GoldenClock.description: [action, lo, hi, speed set name, ms]: the action's clock over [lo, hi) must give ms (to 0.1)

presets.description: [preset key, speed set name, ms]: the clock summed over the preset's segments

Card.description: A skill as the site shows it: the game skill id the presets' damage hits name, its tree facts, and per spec whether (and as which skill) it is shown.

version.description: the skill's alternate version (a `Succession: X` skill when succession-type)

graph_skills.description: the skills (`skills` keys) whose input reaches the card's presets

links_grade.description: grade of the Black Spirit / version link (the tree facts are game data)

entered_by.description: a Black Spirit card: how it is entered on the file's spec(s) — by its own skill's command, or played by a base skill's press under the Black Spirit gate

base_card.description: the base skill the gate names (IsUseableBlackSpritSkillNo)

gate.description: the assumed tests in words; the Black Spirit gauge (CombineWavePoint) is assumed full

timelines.description: a no_damage card: one per way it is pressed

damage_gap.description: a summon card: its damage lands through a summon and is not counted yet ("needs value"); `lines` are `damage_lines` ids with a null %

Moment.description: What decides the frame a choice leaves its action at (item 3): at_once (the first frame), after_hit (right after hit `hit_index` of `of_hits`), window_open (a window opens at f; `after_branch`: an earlier branch on the same input owns the frames before; `window_of`: the window is another branch into the same action), action_end (the action plays to its end; `charge`: a charge held through; `flows`: the clip flows into its next part), release (held keys let go; `when` is the moment it lands). `f` is the clip frame of the action the choice leaves.

target.description: the hop fires on a target in range (the best-case profile assumes one)

charge_keys.description: with `charge`: the held keys whose release fires a continuation (what the player holds through the charge)

Choice.description: One decision on the preset path: leave `from` for `to` on `input`; `moment` says what decides when, `how` says it in a player’s words.

how.description: this choice alone in a player’s words, frame-free

Cancel.description: A true cancel (item 5): the follow-up’s exit opens on the final action before the final hit. Leaving at `f` of `at` (ms_100 from the cast start; `segments` a `segment_lists` key) loses `lost_ticks` (export tick ids), hits `first_lost`..`of_ticks`; `lost_pct` is the confident % they carry, else null with the reason.

AccessEntry.description: One way into a preset or card (item 10): press (the skill’s own input from idle), skill_request (entered by a skill press SKILL_<n>), loop (from an earlier action of the same cast), other_skill / own_skill (a follow-up of an exported preset entering it). A follow-up entry names the preset and the index of its follow-up (which carries the action, frame, input and time). 0.5.1: press = FROM IDLE (an idle row enters it, `idle` the evidence); command = an entry outside the charts; from_skill = the actions entering it, per source skill (own = the preset’s skill, its loop included; all = every action of that skill).

idle.description: press: the idle rows that enter the action (evidence)

all.description: every action of that skill the file exports enters it

ultimate.description: entered through a route-only Ultimate (its command opens this route into the base card) 0.5.7: set only for a real Ultimate (route kind `ultimate`); see `route`.

routes.description: from_skill: per entering action, the routes it enters by (a route-only Ultimate's command, another route-only skill's command — 0.5.7 `skill` — plainly, or a mix)

weapon_switch.description: press: the entry's command is the class's Awakening weapon switch, folded into this card (the input it adds)

Exit.description: An exit of a no-damage card’s timeline, measured from the CAST START at the earliest frame it opens

group.description: plain label: the card(s) it enters, the skill, or "any skill on the hotbar"

at.description: the action the follow-up leaves from

f.description: the frame of `at` it opens at

plays.description: for a follow-up into a skill PRESS (`to` = SKILL_<n>): the action that press plays

cards.description: the card(s) the follow-up enters: the first damage of the action it enters, read by the card rule; several when its branches deal several (a `cards` id each)

no_card.description: why `cards` is empty ('no damage card: ...'), else null

hotbar.description: any skill on the hotbar (a quickslot / console-slot press): one per preset or timeline, the earliest; no card

opens.description: where in its action the hotbar row opens

raw_row.description: the engine row (group) the exit is on — not for display

Timeline.description: One press of a no-damage skill: its default path with nothing extra pressed, its segments (the cast), its exits from the cast start and `free_to_act` (the earliest exit into a skill).

Input.description: An input as structure (user, 2026-10-05): keys held / pressed / double-tapped, keys that must be up (`released`, hidden by default: `hide`), the skill command(s) by name, the hotbar, the window and End, `requires` and `assumed` in plain words, a one-line `text`; the condition text only in `raw`. 0.5.5: each command’s `keys` (the key combos that enter its skill, split into `held` / `press`; inferred), `quickslot_skills` (the skill a hotbar hop uses).

keys.description: the key combos entering the skill (its chain entries): `press` edge keys, `held` level keys — inferred

Route.description: 0.5.7 (user, 2026-10-06): what the route a preset / follow-up / entry is entered through IS. kind `ultimate`: a route-only Ultimate (no input of its own, a combat-tree skill: Ultimate: Crow Flare); `skill`: any other route-only skill folded in (Succession: Imminent Doom, Core: X); `weapon_switch`: the class's Awakening weapon switch (presets and press entries only). `name` is the name to show.

Shadow.description: 0.5.7: SHADOWED — another exit of the same action accepts this input and opens earlier, so pressing or holding early takes it (reference case, measured in game 2026-10-06: Prime: Abyssal Flame's shot -> Shift + E plays the fast Imminent Doom only when pressed late). `kind` early: a press at or after this exit's opening takes this exit; covered: an earlier row is still open at the follow-up's moment. Inferred.

opens_f.description: the frame the pre-empting exit opens (clip frames of the same action)
